reference_scope: The public baseline holds unchanged native counts, ages, support, taxa, PPE, geometry and baseline moments. Per-case SHA256 and ordered per-window SHA256 bind these original records; the separately pinned 1,953,514-byte native report retains all alternative moments and signed differences. This compact account does not duplicate those moment arrays.
limits: Saved K is source-qualified, not independently recomputed. Conditional count/diagonal-PPE delta moments only. Wind2/4 are assumptions, not measurements or probabilities. No cross-window uncertainty, independent core pooling, vegetation accuracy, rights or wholeLCI-030 admission.
development_exposure: The saved Nordic wind3 baseline and earlier Swedish wind2/4 conditional outcomes were exposed before the frozen alternative protocol; this is not untouched confirmation.
